text:
olivia: Heads-up — hotfix PR #4988 touches the request-batching schema and adjusts an index. We need two reviewers to greenlight before today's deploy window closes at 11:45 PT. Tests are passing locally but the migration has a manual step. PR: https://git.company/pr/4988 — can anyone take a quick look?

sam: Can you paste the exact migration steps? I can take it if it's a short one.

olivia: Steps: 1) ./scripts/apply-dev-migration.sh 2) ./tools/e2e.sh --filter batch 3) verify fallback from old clients. Tests locally: all green. It's mostly index changes but we added a compatibility shim so worth a quick pass. cc @jeff @maya

releases-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze starts 12:00 PT. Hotfixes must have approvals + green CI by 11:50 PT to be eligible.

jeff: I'll review now. If it's index-only I can do a quick pass. Which commit should I look at?

olivia: Pushed commit d4c3f2a with initial migration. Added rollback notes in the PR description.

jeff: Quick run locally — left a small comment about wrapping the migration for older PG compatibility (transaction boundaries). If you can address that I can re-check quickly.

olivia: Nice catch. Pushed fix f9b1c3d and added a unit test migration_compat_test.

maya: I'm available to do a final pass after CI finishes. If I'm offline at cutoff @sam can be backup to merge.

sam: Running the manual migration now against the dev snapshot. Local e2e green. LGTM from me pending second approve.

jeff: Re-checked f9b1c3d — looks safe and the test covers the edge. Approving on GH :thumbsup:

maya: CI turned green a minute ago. Leaving my approval on the PR :white_check_mark:.

release-manager: Hotfix PR 4988 is tentatively scheduled into today's 12:15 deploy. We will proceed if it has two approvals and green CI by 11:50 PT. @olivia please confirm readiness.

olivia: Ready to merge — thanks everyone for the quick reviews! Please merge and tag the release. :tada:
